name: On-chain Tarot
description: A polished local three-card tarot ritual with animated dealing and reveals. No wallet or GAS is used while the GameFi contract and domain binding are rebuilt and verified.
description_zh: 精心设计的本地三张塔罗仪式，包含发牌与翻牌动画。GameFi 合约和域名绑定完成重建与验证前，不会连接钱包，也不会使用 GAS。

operation_panel.title: Local Tarot Ritual
operation_panel.subtitle: Choose an intention, shuffle, deal, and reveal locally. Wallet-funded GameFi remains disabled until the replacement contract and domain binding pass the compatibility gate.

oracle.description: Guest readings use local secure randomness. No wallet-funded oracle or settlement path is advertised until a compatible deployment is verified.
